questions.question: What is the Comedian technique?
questions.subject: Comedian

answer.item: This technique allows the user to manifest whatever they think is funny into reality.

questions.question: What is the weakness of the Comedian technique?
questions.subject: Comedian

answer.item: Despite the extraordinary power granted by this technique, Comedian can only be activated if the user remains confident and certain in their ability to be funny. As a result, if the user loses confidence in their humor, the technique will be deactivated and render them vulnerable to attacks.

questions.question: How did Fumihiko Takaba first showcase Comedian?
questions.subject: Comedian

answer.item: Fumihiko Takaba first showcased his innate technique by subtly healing the wounds he suffered from Iori Hazenoki's innate technique. Despite the severe bleeding from his head caused by Iori's explosive tooth, his wounds were shown to have completely healed seconds later.

questions.question: What do the kanji for Comedian mean?
questions.subject: Comedian

answer.item: The kanji used for the name of this technique, means "superhuman" 超人 Chōjin.
